  Exam Date & Time: 25-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VII Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  software Engineering [NPT-4012]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           How do Agile and Waterfall methodologies differ in terms of risk management?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Is it possible to combine software process models for a given project? Justify with  
  suitable example.                                                                           (5)  
  
  2)           Why don't many software developers pay enough attention to requirements engineering?  
  Are there ever circumstances where you can skip it? Justify your answer.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      What strategies can help manage conflicting requirements during validation?                 (3)  
  C)      What is the need for design patterns? Discuss any 2 design patterns with suitable  
  example.                                                                                    (2)  
  
  3)           You are assigned as a business analyst for a software project to develop an online  
  learning platform. Conduct a requirement analysis for this project by identifying and  
  categorizing at least five functional and five non-functional requirements. Discuss the     (5)  
  A)      importance of each category in the context of the project.  
  
  B)      Illustrate with neat sketches, advantages and disadvantages of the Pipes and Filters and  
  layered architectural design models.                                                        (3)  
  
  C)      Compare and contrast software architecture and software design.                             (2)  
  4)           Design the Use case diagrams, class diagrams and sequence diagrams for MIT Sports  
  Management System.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      What elements of a user interface design can be evaluated without building a working  
  computer prototype?                                                                         (3)  
  
  C)      Illustrate any five differences between software test engineer and hardware test engineer. (2)  
  
  5)           Illustrate various defects encountered at different phases of software life cycle.          (5)
